decisionsTitle: A volunteer the club types may have no address or telephone: on the list only
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-28:** «Cand adaug voluntar de mana, as vrea sa pot adaug si fara adresa de mail si telefon, doar sa fie asa pe lista».

**Decision.** Amends §754 — which made the address the volunteer's identity (`UNIQUE (event_id, canonical_email)`, one row per person per event) and required both the address and the telephone number — and §761/§837 (the short email that names the roles given). For a row the club types (`STAFF`: «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» on the event's card and on the «Voluntari» screen, and every «Modifică» of such a row) the address and the telephone number are each optional, on their own; the two boxes say so in both languages, and what an empty address means («Opțional. Fără adresă, persoana apare doar pe listă și nu primește niciun email; contractul se semnează pe hârtie.»). Anything typed is still read as before — an address through the canonicalizer, a telephone number by the registrations' parser — and refused on its box when it is neither. The public form (`PUBLIC`) is exactly as it was, both required; a row the person typed there keeps both on «Modifică» (refused naming each box), and the table holds the same line.

- **The data.** Migration `0182_volunteers_name_only`, expand only (generated by drizzle-kit, renumbered after `0181`): `email`, `canonical_email`, `canonicalization_version` and `phone` lose their NOT NULL, and two CHECKs keep what still holds — `event_volunteers_address_whole` (the address, its canonical form and the canonicalizer's version together, or none of them) and `event_volunteers_public_contact` (a `PUBLIC` row has an address and a telephone number). Every row from before keeps everything.
- **Identity.** The uniqueness holds for the rows that have an address: PostgreSQL's `UNIQUE` compares no two NULLs, so two name-only rows of one name both stand — a name is no identity, and no index was added. An address typed into a name-only row later meets the uniqueness then, refused on the email box with what was typed kept (`VOLUNTEER_ALREADY_LISTED`) when another row of the event holds it; an address cleared meets nothing and, like a corrected one, kills a live agreement link.
- **No email of any kind.** A row without an address is never queued a message — no outbox row at all, not even one withdrawn later: not the roles given, taken back, changed in «Modifică» or announced on a reopening (`queueRoleAssigned`), not the agreement's copy after «Semnat pe hârtie» or after the link, not the volunteer's copy after the parent's paper. The verbs that only send an email — «Trimite linkul contractului» and «Trimite linkul părintelui» — are not drawn for such a row; one line says why where the button would be («Fără adresă de email: linkul nu se poate trimite.»; «Voluntarul nu are adresă de email: nu i se trimite nimic, nici linkul părintelui. Acordul se ia pe hârtie.»), and the service refuses a forged or stale post with `VOLUNTEER_NO_EMAIL` (a sentence in both catalogues), writing nothing. The person's agreements are on paper: the PDF to sign and «Semnat pe hârtie» stay, and its question no longer promises a copy by email. A message queued while the row still had an address is withdrawn at the send once the address is cleared. The toast after «Dă-i rolul» or «Ia-i rolul» on such a row says the person gets no email («spune-i tu»).
- **An address typed in later** tells the person, once, the roles they hold: the «readdressed» message §837 already sends to a corrected address.
- **What is shown.** The person's block — the event's card and `/admin/volunteers/[id]` — draws the address and the telephone number as links only when the row has them, never a `mailto:` or a `tel:` to nothing and never «null», and, without an address, one line: «Fără adresă de email: e doar pe listă și nu primește niciun email.» The CSV and both Excel files leave the two cells empty and move no column; the public list, the badges and the organizers' notice never read an address.
- **«Toate datele unei persoane»** searches by address, so it never lists a name-only row: such a row is read and deleted on the event's card or the «Voluntari» screen, and the thirty-day sweep takes it like every offer (§754's retention unchanged).
- **A public sign-up** of a person the club had typed without an address finds no row to call a repeat and is a second row; the organizers see both and delete one.

**Refused.** Matching a hand entry or a sign-up by name (two people share a name; the address stays the identity wherever there is one). A placeholder address to keep the column NOT NULL (it would be mailed and would clash with the next one). Sending the parent's link to the guardian of a volunteer with no address (the row is on the list only; its agreements are on paper, the guardian's too). A partial unique index on the address (the constraint already compares no two NULLs; a second index would be a second rule). Making the public form's boxes optional (the owner asked for the club's own entries).

Amends §754, §761 and §837.
changelogLine: - **A volunteer added by hand without an email or a phone** — «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» and «Modifică» take the address and the telephone as optional for the club's own entries; such a person is on the list only: no email of any kind, the agreement signed on paper, and one line saying why where the email buttons were. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 121 (§754, §761, §837). Given «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» on the event's card or on the «Voluntari» screen, or «Modifică» of a row an organizer typed (`STAFF`), when the address, the telephone number or both are left empty, then the row is kept with each missing one null — the address, its canonical form and the canonicalizer's version together — and both boxes say, in Română and in English, that they are optional and that a person without an address only appears on the list and receives no email; anything typed that is no address, or no number a phone can dial, is refused naming its box; two such rows of one name both stand; an address typed into such a row later meets the event's uniqueness and is refused on the email box (`VOLUNTEER_ALREADY_LISTED`) when another row holds it; a row the person typed on the public form (`PUBLIC`) keeps both required on «Modifică», refused naming each box, and the public form still asks both (2026-10-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer with no address, when an organizer gives a role, takes one back, changes the roles in «Modifică», reopens the person, or records the agreement or the parent's consent on paper, then no outbox row is queued for anyone — not even one withdrawn later — and a message queued while the row still had an address is withdrawn at the send once the address is cleared; «Trimite linkul contractului» and «Trimite linkul părintelui» are not drawn for such a row, one line in both languages says why where each would be, and a post of either is refused (`VOLUNTEER_NO_EMAIL`) with nothing written; an address typed in later tells the person, once, the roles they hold (2026-10-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer with no address or no telephone number, when the person's block (the event's card, `/admin/volunteers/[id]`), the «Voluntari» list, the CSV, the Excel files, the public list or the badges' count reads them, then a missing one is an empty cell or simply absent — never «null», never a `mailto:` or a `tel:` to nothing — and the block says once that the person is on the list only (2026-10-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Migration `0182_volunteers_name_only` is expand-only: it drops the NOT NULL of `event_volunteers.email`, `canonical_email`, `canonicalization_version` and `phone`, and adds the CHECKs `event_volunteers_address_whole` (the three address columns together or none) and `event_volunteers_public_contact` (a `PUBLIC` row has an address and a telephone number); the rows from before keep everything, and `UNIQUE (event_id, canonical_email)` still refuses one address twice on an event (2026-10-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a volunteer added by hand without an email or a phone, on the list only
